meta_description: Blackstone Decorators is a trusted painter and decorator in Birmingham. Interior and exterior work, free quotes, fully insured. Call 07727 293087 today.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured — Free Quotes, No Pressure
hero_subhead: Interior redecoration, exterior painting, and specialist finishes. Get your home refresh started today with a no-obligation quote.
services_heading: Painting and Decorating Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From interior walls and ceilings to exterior rendering and woodwork, we handle every aspect of your redecoration project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Redecorating
services.desc: Full room refresh including wall and ceiling painting, wallpapering, and feature walls. We protect your furniture and leave the space spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting
services.desc: Weather-resistant exterior work on fascias, soffits, doors, and render. Properly prepared and sealed to last years, not months.

services.title: Woodwork and Joinery
services.desc: Sanding, priming, and finishing internal doors, skirtings, and window frames. We use premium paint systems for a smooth, durable finish.

services.title: Wallpapering
services.desc: Professional hanging of standard and feature wallpapers, including pattern matching and removal of old coverings before preparation.

services.title: Commercial Painting
services.desc: Offices, shops, and industrial spaces. We work to your schedule and finish on time, with minimal disruption to your business.

services.title: Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Textured coatings, faux effects, Venetian plaster, and bespoke colour matching. Transform any room with a truly individual look.

about_pullquote: I started Blackstone because I was tired of shoddy paintwork being passed off as professional.
about_para_1: Blackstone Decorators was founded 18 years ago on a simple principle: take pride in the detail. We've since completed over 800 interior and exterior projects across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, building a reputation for honest work and fair pricing. Every member of our team is fully qualified and fully insured.
about_para_2: Our customers return because we listen, we turn up on time, and we leave your home in a state you're genuinely happy with. We don't cut corners or use cheap materials — we use paints and finishes that last, and we take time to prepare surfaces properly. That's why we get so many repeat bookings and referrals.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had the entire downstairs redecorated. The lads were tidy, quick, and really knew their stuff. Prep work was thorough and the finish is absolutely brilliant. Couldn't fault them. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Mark T.

reviews.text: Got quotes from three decorators. Blackstone was clear about what they'd do and what it would cost — no surprises. Did my hallway, landing, and two bedrooms in four days. Absolutely professional, left no mess. Top marks.
reviews.author: Susan W.

reviews.text: Exterior rendering and woodwork looked rough. Rang Blackstone on the Monday, came out same day to quote, started work the following week. Finished bang on schedule, looks like new. Really impressed. Will use again for the inside.
reviews.author: David R.
